description: Source code for Timesheet document handling in ERPNext, including validation, calculation, overlap checking, and related data retrieval functions.

classes.name: OverlapError
classes.description: Custom validation error for overlapping timesheet entries.

classes.name: OverWorkLoggedError
classes.description: Custom validation error for over-logged work in timesheets.

classes.name: Timesheet
classes.description: Main class representing a timesheet document with methods for validation, calculation, and state management.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the timesheet, including employee status, dates, and time logs.

methods.name: set_employee_name
methods.description: Sets the employee name based on employee ID.

methods.name: calculate_total_amounts
methods.description: Calculates total hours, amounts, and billing details from time logs.

methods.name: calculate_percentage_billed
methods.description: Calculates the percentage of billed amount relative to billable amount.

methods.name: update_billing_hours
methods.description: Updates billing hours for a time log based on billability.

methods.name: set_status
methods.description: Sets the status of the timesheet based on document state and billing progress.

methods.name: set_dates
methods.description: Sets start and end dates based on time logs.

methods.name: before_cancel
methods.description: Pre-cancellation hook to set status.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Handles logic when timesheet is canceled.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Handles logic when timesheet is submitted.

methods.name: validate_mandatory_fields
methods.description: Ensures mandatory fields in time logs are filled.

methods.name: update_task_and_project
methods.description: Updates related task and project documents based on time logs.

methods.name: validate_dates
methods.description: Validates that 'to' date is not before 'from' date.

methods.name: validate_time_logs
methods.description: Validates each time log for overlaps and project consistency.

methods.name: validate_overlap
methods.description: Checks for overlapping time logs.

methods.name: get_overlap_for
methods.description: Retrieves overlapping time logs from database.

methods.name: set_project
methods.description: Assigns project to a time log if missing.

methods.name: validate_project
methods.description: Ensures project consistency within timesheet.

methods.name: update_cost
methods.description: Updates billing and costing amounts for time logs.

methods.name: update_time_rates
methods.description: Sets billing rate to zero if not billable.

methods.name: get_projectwise_timesheet_data
methods.description: Fetches timesheet data grouped by project.

methods.name: get_timesheet_detail_rate
methods.description: Calculates billing amount for a timesheet detail with currency conversion.

methods.name: get_timesheet
methods.description: Searches for timesheets based on filters.

methods.name: get_timesheet_data
methods.description: Retrieves detailed timesheet data for billing.

methods.name: make_sales_invoice
methods.description: Creates a sales invoice from a timesheet.

methods.name: make_salary_slip
methods.description: Creates a salary slip from a timesheet.

methods.name: set_missing_values
methods.description: Sets default values for salary slip based on timesheet.

methods.name: get_activity_cost
methods.description: Retrieves activity cost rates, with currency conversion.

methods.name: get_events
methods.description: Returns calendar events for timesheets.

methods.name: get_timesheets_list
methods.description: Lists timesheets for user portal, filtered by customer.

methods.name: get_list_context
methods.description: Provides context for timesheet list view.
